title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
layout_note: Left panel: role agents placed around a central shared message store (two above, two below, one at the right), each joined to it by a blue double-headed arrow, with publish/subscribe tabs on the store's right edge and a tools legend under the panel. Right panel: a zoom into one role, joined to its avatar on the left by thin curved black lines: a profile card on top, then a memory strip and an iterative code-execute-debug loop below.
grouping: Each panel is a large rounded rectangle; the right one has a light blue-grey fill with white inner cards. The shared message store is a lavender rounded panel with a dashed outline and a bold serif title; inside it, individual messages are grey tag chips (msgA–msgD) bracketed to one expanded message showing its structured fields as key: value lines. A dotted rectangle encloses the programming loop in the zoom panel. Tools are listed in a separate legend box under the left panel, each with its icon.
shapes_depth: Flat. Agents are round cartoon avatar portraits on blue discs with the role name in bold serif below and a tool icon plus name beside it. Memory is a horizontal segmented strip (a tape of cells, one highlighted). The generated code is a syntax-coloured listing; the document being written is a yellow sticky note with a folded corner. Thin dotted arrows carry messages between agents, bold blue arrows join agents to the store, thin black arrows run the programming loop, whose two exits are marked by a red cross (to Debug) and a green check (Add Code). An ear icon marks subscription.
proposed_highlight: The shared message pool is the hub everyone connects to and the only lavender region; the per-agent mechanism is shown in an enlarged detail panel on the right with its own memory strip and feedback loop.
lesson: For a team of role agents, place avatar portraits around a central shared store linked by double-headed arrows, show one message expanded as key: value fields, and pull one agent out into a side panel that zooms into its profile, memory and execute-feedback loop.
notes: elements 'other' = the memory tape strip, the sticky-note document and the check/cross outcome glyphs. Venue and year from the PDF first page ('Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2024').

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
